$comment: Metadata for conversion rules. Implementations live in packages/converter/src/rules. Every rule listed here must have exactly one implementation (enforced by tests).

rules.name: Update pack description metadata and pack_format
rules.description: Preserves description, unknown fields, features, filter, language and overlays while setting pack_format to the target resource pack format.

rules.name: Migrate pack.mcmeta to min_format and max_format
rules.description: For resource pack format 69 (1.21.9) and newer, removes supported_formats and writes min_format/max_format. pack_format is kept only when the pack also declares support for older formats.

rules.name: Rename legacy texture folders
rules.description: Renames textures/blocks to textures/block and textures/items to textures/item, as introduced by the flattening in resource pack format 4 (1.13).

rules.name: Convert legacy item model overrides to items model definitions
rules.description: For resource pack format 46 (1.21.4) and newer, creates assets/<namespace>/items/<id>.json from legacy overrides and removes the overrides field from the source model. Only predicates with a verified equivalent are converted; models containing unsupported predicates are left untouched and reported.

rules.name: Detect removed legacy_unicode font providers
rules.description: The legacy_unicode glyph provider was removed in resource pack format 15 (1.20). Glyph data cannot be reconstructed automatically, so affected font files are preserved and reported as unsupported.

rules.name: Validate that textures are PNG files
rules.description: Resource pack format 22 (1.20.3) only supports .png textures. Non-PNG texture files are reported and preserved.

rules.name: Validate font providers and referenced files
rules.description: Checks font JSON syntax, provider types, TTF shift bounds and referenced font textures.

rules.name: Detect shaders without automatic conversion
rules.description: Shader and post-process formats changed repeatedly. GLSL and shader JSON are validated for syntax where possible but are never rewritten automatically.

rules.name: Validate sounds.json and referenced audio files
rules.description: Checks sounds.json structure and ensures referenced .ogg files exist in the pack. Audio content is never re-encoded.

rules.name: Validate blockstates and model references
rules.description: Checks variants/multipart structure, model references, rotation and weight fields.

rules.name: Validate atlas definitions
rules.description: Checks atlas JSON syntax and source directory references.

rules.name: Validate textures and animation metadata
rules.description: Checks PNG signatures and .png.mcmeta animation data without recompressing images.

rules.name: Preserve unknown files
rules.description: Files that are not recognized as Minecraft resources are copied unchanged and listed in the report.
